svg.title: Consume authorization and issuance: 11 of 12 substeps landed, 0 in progress, 1 open.
svg.desc: A01 authorizer enrollment, A02 post-plan caller control and A03 encrypted-original format are committed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8. A04 durable ciphertext storage, A05 verified retained export, A06 root-controlled key and storage delivery, A07 cold planner connection and A08 private export service are committed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. A09 independent receiving-purpose custody and A10 independent original-proof replay are committed in b3c9a58472b788b8f06e3824cd57b6f345ecf6c2. A11 actual consume-grant issuance and verification and all five detail steps are source-landed in 4b421e2d26777b904ebe807fcd9dce367a8826f6: wire/signature contract, caller/root admission and derived claims, producer, independent verifier, source integration and consumer join. A12 cold consume-grant service is NEXT/OPEN; cold signer/key/FD delivery and private serving remain unfinished. Eleven substeps are landed, none are in progress and one is open. Each numbered segment has a visible name and written status. These twelve substeps and the five-part A11 detail are nested inside token-release row 11, which remains in progress, not new project milestones. Token release remains 10/16, activation 19/26 and project 34/46 source-landed. Counts are nonadditive, not effort percentages. Source is unbuilt and unexecuted; source completion is not test or runtime credit. Production acceptance remains 0/6 verified.

g.text: One segment per named substep · committed source, not an estimate of remaining effort
